concept.title: The labels do not agree
concept.shortdesc: Each directory uses a different set of categories, or none, so a category in one cannot be matched to a category in another.

ul.li: three use lists maintained for local government
one uses a scheme of its own
two use older schemes of their own
two carry no categories at all

conbody.p: There is no dependable way to say that a category in one directory means the same as a category in another.
